FAQ

What is Cosmic Universe?

A 5,555-piece deep-space NFT collection on BNB Chain — galaxies, planets, stars, nebulae, black holes, and space exploration.

How to mint NFT?

Connect a BNB Chain wallet (or use the Binance Agentic Wallet agent prompt once the contract is deployed), choose a quantity up to 10, confirm the transaction in your wallet, and check the hash on BscScan.

Which wallet is supported?

Binance Agentic Wallet (via agent prompt) and EVM browser wallets on BNB Smart Chain via Connect Wallet.

What is the mint price?

Flat 0.0005 BNB per NFT.

Which blockchain is used?

BNB Smart Chain (chain ID 56), ERC-721 / BEP-721.

How can I view my NFT?

After minting, open your token on BscScan via its transaction hash, or read tokenURI from the contract — it points to the token metadata.
